steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Enter Programming Mode (P-E)
steps.body: Hold fresh food door light switch closed. Press Freezer DOWN 3 times within 10 seconds. Release door switch — display shows P-E. Press Freezer DOWN once more to confirm entry.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Freezer Temperature DOWN /- Key pad 3 times consecutively.

steps.title: Validate program code
steps.body: Control displays current program code. Compare to code on serial plate after word CODE. Unit will NOT run with program code OO.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Control displays current program code. Compare to code on serial plate after word CODE. Unit will NOT run with program code OO.

steps.title: Program code matches serial plate
steps.body: Does displayed program code match the serial plate?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Does displayed program code match the serial plate?

steps.title: Set program code
steps.body: Use Freezer and Refrigerator UP keys to advance digit. Press Freezer DOWN until code flashes (saved). Close door to exit. Repeat if incorrect.
steps.sourceExcerpt: The unit will NOT run with a Program Code of OO.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Jazz French Door Refrigerator (W10322959B, 19–22 cu ft)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Test Mode
steps.body: Service Test Mode (S-E) entered. Use Freezer UP/DOWN to select the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: You are now in the SERVICES TEST operational mode and may use the diagnostic tests.

steps.title: Select Service Test 1
steps.body: In Service Test Mode (S-E), use Freezer UP/DOWN keys until freezer display shows 1. Refrigerator display blank until test is activated.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Test 1 — Defrost thermostat & heater

steps.title: Activate test 1
steps.body: Press Refrigerator UP to activate. Defrost heater energizes. Observe heat and thermostat state on display.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Refrigerator Temperature UP /+ key to activate test.

steps.title: Defrost thermostat display
steps.body: Freezer shows 1. Refrigerator shows O (thermostat open) or S (shorted/closed). Does display match expected state for evaporator temperature?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Freezer shows 1. Refrigerator shows O (thermostat open) or S (shorted/closed). Does display match expected state for evaporator temperature?

steps.title: Deactivate test 1
steps.body: Press Refrigerator UP to deactivate test before leaving test 1. Test must be OFF to select another test.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Refrigerator UP to deactivate test before leaving test 1. Test must be OFF to select another test.

steps.title: Disconnect power for ohms
steps.body: Unplug refrigerator for resistance checks on defrost heater and bimetal.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug refrigerator for resistance checks on defrost heater and bimetal.

steps.title: Defrost heater resistance
steps.body: Measure defrost heater — 19 cu 33 Ω, 22 cu 30 Ω, 20/25 cu 28 Ω @ 115 VAC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure defrost heater — 19 cu 33 Ω, 22 cu 30 Ω, 20/25 cu 28 Ω @ 115 VAC.

steps.title: Defrost thermostat (bimetal) resistance
steps.body: Closed above 42°F (few Ω); open below 12°F (OL). Must be closed when evaporator frosted.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Closed above 42°F (few Ω); open below 12°F (OL). Must be closed when evaporator frosted.

steps.body: In Service Test Mode (S-E), use Freezer UP/DOWN keys until freezer display shows 2. Refrigerator display blank until test is activated.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Test 2 — Compressor/condenser fan

steps.title: Activate test 2
steps.body: Press Refrigerator UP to toggle compressor/condenser fan ON (O) or OFF (F). Freezer displays 2.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Refrigerator UP to toggle compressor/condenser fan ON (O) or OFF (F). Freezer displays 2.

steps.title: Compressor and condenser fan run
steps.body: With test activated ON (refrigerator O), do compressor and condenser fan operate normally?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Compressor or condenser fan does not run — bench test windings and start device.

steps.sourceExcerpt: With test activated ON (refrigerator O), do compressor and condenser fan operate normally?

steps.title: Deactivate test 2
steps.body: Toggle to OFF (F) before selecting another test.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Toggle to OFF (F) before selecting another test.

steps.title: Disconnect power for compressor ohms
steps.body: Unplug unit. Access compressor terminals and relay/capacitor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug unit. Access compressor terminals and relay/capacitor.

steps.title: Compressor run winding (EM2Y60)
steps.body: Run winding 4.75 Ω ±8% between run and common.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run winding 4.75 Ω ±8% between run and common.

steps.title: Compressor start winding
steps.body: Start winding 6.1 Ω ±8% @ 77°F. Run capacitor 12 µfd ±10%.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Start winding 6.1 Ω ±8% @ 77°F. Run capacitor 12 µfd ±10%.

steps.title: Check relay and run capacitor
steps.body: Verify TSD2/5sP overload/relay and 12 µfd run capacitor. LRA 10.8 A; FLA 1.60 A per spec.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify TSD2/5sP overload/relay and 12 µfd run capacitor. LRA 10.8 A; FLA 1.60 A per spec.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Compressor or condenser fan does not run — bench test windings and start device.

steps.body: In Service Test Mode (S-E), use Freezer UP/DOWN keys until freezer display shows 7. Refrigerator display blank until test is activated.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Test 7 — FF performance adjustment

steps.title: Adjust FF performance offset
steps.body: Service Test 7 adjusts fresh food performance ±1° per step. WARMER ← (1 2 3 4 (5) 6 7 8 9) → COLDER using Refrigerator UP/DOWN. Default is 5. Last value saves when refrigerator door closes. Use only when cabinet temps verified normal and complaint is mild FF offset.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Adjustments of Service Test 7 will alter the performance of the unit.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Test 9 — Defrost interval

steps.title: Adaptive vs fixed defrost
steps.body: Press Refrigerator UP to toggle: A=Adaptive (default) or F=Fixed 6-hour defrost. Freezer displays 9. Which mode is required?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Refrigerator UP to toggle: A=Adaptive (default) or F=Fixed 6-hour defrost. Freezer displays 9. Which mode is required?

steps.title: Adaptive defrost reference
steps.body: Adaptive defrost: 15 min optimum; board terminates at 25 min if bimetal stuck. 4 hr continuous compressor run resets interval to 8 hr and initiates defrost. Close door to save setting and exit Service Test Mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Adaptive defrost: 15 min optimum; board terminates at 25 min if bimetal stuck. 4 hr continuous compressor run resets interval to 8 hr and initiates defrost. Close door to save setting and exit Service Test Mode.
